5 GPU suite(s) did not run: mivisionx, robustness, rocal, roccv, rocpydecode. Only the suites with `needs_gpu: false` ran, and the night was not recorded as tested, so the next poll tests the release again.
No GPU for 1 night(s). Report: https://levxn.github.io/vision-pack-test/nightly/2026-10-23/

Check the runner host: is the amdgpu driver loaded (`/dev/kfd`, `/dev/dri/renderD*`, `/sys/class/kfd/kfd/topology/nodes`)? Does the build target its GPU (`build_tools/detect_gpu.sh --manifest <manifest>`)? See `infra::no-gpu` in docs/triage.md.
